steps.en: Install the desktop app (release installer or a package manager)
steps.zh: 装上桌面应用（发布页安装包或包管理器）

steps.en: Import your subscription URL as a profile
steps.zh: 把订阅链接导入成一个配置文件

steps.en: Fetches it and applies your global and per-profile extend configs and scripts
steps.zh: 下载订阅，依次套上全局和单个订阅的扩展配置与脚本

steps.en: Pick a node and a mode, then switch on System Proxy or TUN
steps.zh: 选节点和模式，打开系统代理或 TUN

steps.en: Starts the mihomo kernel (via its privileged service for TUN) and points the OS at it
steps.zh: 拉起 mihomo 内核（TUN 经特权服务），把系统流量指过去

steps.en: Routes each connection by your rules: matched traffic via the node, the rest direct
steps.zh: 按规则分流：命中的走节点，其余直连

value.en: Rule-based split routing for the whole desktop, terminal tools included, without hand-editing YAML or OS proxy settings
value.zh: 整台电脑按规则分流，命令行工具也算在内，不用手改 YAML 和系统代理设置

sources: https://clash-verge-rev.github.io/guide/quickstart.html (import subscription, pick node and mode, enable system proxy or TUN)
https://clash-verge-rev.github.io/guide/extend.html (execution chain: app settings, global extend config, global script, profile config, profile script, settings write-back)
https://clash-verge-rev.github.io/guide/term.html (service mode launches the kernel with admin rights so TUN works without running the GUI as admin)
